recognize_zh: 淋巴結被瀰漫、單調一致的小到中型淋巴球取代，核稍不規則、胞質稀少，缺乏大型中心母細胞與免疫母細胞，間有少數淡粉紅色組織球與玻璃樣小血管，這種單形性表現是套細胞淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Diffuse effacement by monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Slightly irregular to round nuclei with dispersed-to-condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; absence of admixed large transformed cells
Small hyalinized vessels; vague nodularity with darker zones
describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse to vaguely nodular effacement by a monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclei, dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Large transformed cells and proliferation centers are not identified. Scattered pink histiocytes and small hyalinized vessels are present. Findings are suggestive of mantle cell lymphoma; confirmation with CD20, CD5, cyclin D1 and SOX11 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: SLL has pale proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is CD23+/LEF1+, cyclin D1-negative.
FL shows back-to-back neoplastic follicles with centrocytes and admixed centroblasts and is CD10+/BCL6+.
MZL cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm and plasmacytic differentiation and are CD5-/cyclin D1-negative.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finer blastic chromatin, a high mitotic rate and TdT positivity.
